mentions.name: Unbreakable multi-device data storage system
mentions.description: A proposed GPLv3-licensed storage system that keeps data unbreakable and consistent across multiple storage devices. It plans automatic serverless backups, a unified index of all file metadata regardless of how many HDDs/SSDs are connected, priority-based replication of files into multiple copies, easy encryption of all devices with no ties to commercial entities, and an accessible interface.
mentions.problem: Avoiding digital data loss and keeping files consistent across many HDD/SSD devices, since backups should be automatic and serverless and all file metadata should always be known no matter which devices are connected.
mentions.audience: Individual users managing their own data across multiple storage devices
mentions.source_excerpt: How to make data storage on multiple storage devices unbreakable and consistent? The former means for me that back-ups should be automatical and serverless, the latter means that no matter how much of that HDD/SDD devices are connected, I want always to know all metadata of all files I have. I want this software under GPLv3
